# Tiffin Scenic Studios

> > Tiffin Scenic Studios provides professional stage and theatre rigging equipment, athletic facility rigging solutions, and ANSI E1.47-compliant inspection services from Tiffin, Ohio.

Specializing in manual and dead hung rigging systems, counterweight arbors, proscenium stage setups, sports netting, and acoustic banners for performance venues, schools, stadiums, and gyms. The company offers custom design services, fall protection systems, and sustainable rigging solutions with a focus on safety and compliance.

## Key Topics

- Stage rigging and theatre equipment
- Manual rigging and counterweight systems
- Proscenium stage setups
- Dead hung rigging with Unistrut
- ANSI E1.47 rigging inspections
- OSHA compliance and fall protection
- Sports netting materials (Nylon, Polyester, Polypropylene, Kevlar)
- Acoustic banners for sound control
- Budget-friendly school and community theatre solutions
- Sustainable and eco-friendly theatre equipment
- Athletic facility and stadium rigging
- Box arbors and head blocks
- Theatre truss systems
- Overhead rigging safety

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Stage & Sports Services | Inspections & Fall Protection](https://tiffinscenic.com/services): Custom design, ANSI E1.47 inspections, and fall protection services
- [Manual Stage & Theatre Rigging Equipment](https://tiffinscenic.com/stage-theatre-rigging-equipment/manual): Manual rigging: counterweight arbors, head blocks, and locking rails
- [Dead Hung Stage & Theatre Rigging | Tiffin Scenic Studios](https://tiffinscenic.com/stage-theatre-rigging-equipment/dead-hung): Dead hung rigging systems with Unistrut and pipe battens
- [Proscenium Stage Rigging & Setup | Tiffin Scenic Studios](https://tiffinscenic.com/athletic-performance-rigging/proscenium-stage-setups): Proscenium stage rigging converts arenas into intimate theatre spaces
- [Acoustic Stage & Theatre Banners | Tiffin Scenic Studios](https://tiffinscenic.com/stage-theatre-rigging-equipment/acoustic-stage-theatre-banners): Acoustic banners for theatre sound control and echo reduction
